title: Berbice Rebellion
text: The Berbice Rebellion was a slave rebellion in Berbice, Dutch Guiana, that began on 27 February 1763 and lasted to April 1764, with among them the famous rebel leader Cuffy. This was the first major slave revolt in South America, and it is seen as a major event in Guyana's anti-colonial struggles. When Guyana became an independent republic in 1970 the state declared the anniversary of Cuffy's slave rebellion on 23 February as the Republic Day, a day to commemorate the start of the Berbice slave revolt. Cuffy is a national hero commemorated in a large monument in the capital, Georgetown.
